name: forgemarket-discord
description: ForgeMarket Discord ecosystem — server setup + AI support/community bot.

scripts.env:example: node --input-type=module -e "import {ENV_SPEC} from './src/runtime.js';import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';const w=t=>t.match(/.{1,72}(\\s|$)/g).map(l=>'# '+l.trim()).join('\\n');const s=(t,r)=>t+'\\n'+r.map(([k,y])=>w(y)+'\\n'+k+'=').join('\\n\\n');writeFileSync('.env.example',['# ForgeMarket Discord bot — environment','#','# Copy to .env for a local run; on Railway set these as service variables','# instead (see README.md → Railway). Never commit a filled-in copy.','#','# GENERATED from ENV_SPEC in src/runtime.js — the same list the bot validates','# against at startup, so this file cannot drift from what the code expects.','# Regenerate with: npm run env:example','',s('# --- Required ---------------------------------------------------------',ENV_SPEC.required),'',s('# --- Strongly recommended: without these, features silently stay off ---',ENV_SPEC.recommended),'',s('# --- Optional ---------------------------------------------------------',ENV_SPEC.optional),''].join('\\n'))"
